newsitem.title: USA: Clorox on track for higher fiscal '97 net.
newsitem.headline: Clorox on track for higher fiscal '97 net.

text.p: Clorox Co said Wednesday it is on track for higher fiscal 1997 earnings even after earnings dilution from its recently acquired Armor All business.
"We don't make specific projections, though," said Fred Reicker, spokesman for the consumer products company best known for its liquid cleaning bleach.
The company earned $4.28 per share in fiscal 1996 ending June 30. The First Call consensus analysts' per share estimate for fiscal 1997 is $4.73.

Earlier, Clorox reported earnings for the third quarter ended March 31 of $1.27 per share versus $1.15. The third quarter earnings were $0.05 per share higher than the First Call consensus analysts' estimate.
Third quarter revenues were $649.2 million, up 16 percent from $560.1 million a year ago.
The earnings reflect a $0.03 a share dilution from its Armor All acquisition which was made late 1996.
Clorox said the integration of the automotive cleaning products company is going well and should be completed by May. Clorox also said third quarter shipments for Armor All were strong.
The company attributed third quarter earnings growth in part to cost cutting initiatives and new products, particularly product extensions of its Clorox 2 line of color-safe bleaches.
Clorox said total shipments were up 16 percent for the first nine months of the 1997 fiscal year.
